title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
blurb: Classifies images with an almost unmodified Transformer encoder by treating fixed-size image patches as tokens.
intro: ViT's only image-specific component is the patch embedding: cut the image into $P \times P$ patches, flatten each, and project it to the model width. A learned `[CLS]` token and a learned position table are added, a pre-LN encoder runs over the sequence, and a linear head reads `[CLS]`. The steps build the input side and the attention sublayer; the capstone runs the full model from pixels to logits.

steps.name: Patch embedding with a class token
